notes: The launcher rests on the shoulder with both arms up. onMount raises both arms (armReadyBoth) and onUnMount plays root, which lowers them; the image's both_arms holds both arms up while it is held and lets them go when it goes. onUnMount calls Parent::onMount, not Parent::onUnMount: that only sets the emptied slot's ammo and skips the stock thread-2 root, and the launcher plays nothing on thread 2, so a player sees no difference. Everything else (the shot, the missile, the blast, its brick damage, debris, light, shake and sounds) is the Add-On's own data.
